items.title: MHRA could allow schools to hold reserves of nasal adrenaline spray
items.summary: Though schools already store autoinjectors like EpiPen, a nasal spray would offer another easy-to-use option.

items.title: FDA approves Viatris’ Ryzumvi for adult presbyopia
items.summary: The US FDA has approved Viatris' Ryzumvi (phentolamine ophthalmic solution 0.75%) to treat presbyopia in adults.

items.title: Estuary secures $103m to advance kidney disease gene therapies
items.summary: Estuary Biotherapeutics has launched after securing $103m in total committed financing for developing targeted gene therapies to treat kidney diseases.

items.title: Lilly’s Foundayo wins EMA panel backing for obesity and type 2 diabetes
items.summary: Foundayo is on course to join Novo’s oral Wegovy in the European oral GLP-1RA market.

items.title: Can smarter technology selection help de-risk small-molecule development?
items.summary: Predictive modelling for drug formulation helps developers select promising approaches and identify manufacturing challenges earlier.
